Başlangıç bugünkü net servet. Kart ve KM: The starting point is today's net worth. Card and overdraft debt are treated as paid from cash in the first month; loan debt falls according to the instalment schedule.
Düzenli gelir ve giderler bugünkü tutarl: Recurring income and expenses enter at today's amounts once their start dates arrive; one-month exceptions are ignored.
Kategori limitleri her ay harcanmış sayı: Category limits are treated as spent every month. Irregular income and expenses repeat every month at the average of the last 12 completed months (by budget month), which also spreads once-a-year costs across the months. One-off spending isn't filtered out: leaving it out makes the forecast genuinely too low.

Zam her Ocak uygulanır; enflasyon giderl: Pay rises are applied every January; inflation is applied to expenses every month (compounded monthly, reaching the annual rate over 12 months). The return accrues monthly on positive cash only. Loan instalments don't increase.
Ev, araba gibi varlıklar bugünkü değeriy: Assets such as a house or car stay at today's value; they aren't included in the return or cash calculation.
Bir krediyi ayrıca düzenli gider olarak: If you've also entered a loan as a recurring expense, it is deducted twice.
